## Current catalog, exactly

The active config is [main.ts](/Users/liamellis/Desktop/apps/ultraterrestrial-resurrection/apps/app/.storybook/main.ts):

- Storybook `9.1.6`.
- Only this story glob is active: `../src/**/*.stories.@(js|jsx|ts|tsx)`.
- 324 matching files, all `.stories.tsx`.
- Every file declares an explicit `title`.
- 324 unique titles.
- 815 story entries.
- 324 autodocs entries, from global `tags: ['autodocs']`.
- 1,139 total unique IDs; no duplicate/hard ID collisions.
- Two MDX files are excluded:
  - `PlanetJourney.overview.stories.mdx`
  - `Introduction.stories.mdx`
- The comment claiming “all 91 story files” is stale by 233 files.

The built index at `apps/app/storybook-static/index.json` is a reliable exact census: all 324 source files map one-to-one, none are missing/extra, and no story file is newer than the index.

Top-level title roots are inconsistent: `Mindmap` 148 titles, `Documents` 38, `Components` 36, down to `Brand` 1. There is also a separate `MindMap` spelling.

## Official naming convention

Titles are manually assigned slash hierarchies, usually:

```text
Root/Area/Component
```

Story IDs are Storybook’s slug of `title + export`, for example:

```text
Documents/DocumentLibrary + WithSearch
→ documents-documentlibrary--with-search
```

There is no `titlePrefix`, no filesystem-generated hierarchy, and no enforced house style. PascalCase component names, spaced names, and hyphenated roots coexist.

## Collision audit

There are zero literal ID collisions today. The semantic collision zone is already crowded:

- `Documents/Toolbar/DynamicToolbar` versus `Components/Toolbars/Dynamic Toolbar`.
- `Documents/Polaroid` versus `Documents/PolaroidCard`.
- `Design System/Typography/Font Showcase` versus `Design System/Typography/Fonts`, both exporting `AllFonts`.
- `Documents/CrashRetrievals` versus `Documents/Crash Retrievals/*`.
- `Documents/CaseFileFolder` versus `Documents/Case Files/*`.
- Roswell document variants are split between top-level and `Report Files`.
- `Brand/*`, `Design System/*`, and `Documents/*` are separate roots despite representing one design system.

The reference prototype also overlaps real components. Its `UFODispatchDocument` is effectively a refined Socorro version of the existing `Documents/Crash Retrievals/EventDispatchDoc`. Copying it into `Documents/*` as another sibling would create duplicate product concepts even if the IDs remain technically unique.

## Safest location and naming

For source studies that are not yet production components, use:

```text
apps/app/src/stories/design-sources/
├── brand-bible/
└── reference-prototype/
```

Use an isolated explicit title root:

```text
Design Sources/Brand Bible/Overview
Design Sources/Brand Bible/Visual Modes
Design Sources/Brand Bible/Polaroid Specification
Design Sources/Reference Prototype/Documents
Design Sources/Reference Prototype/Layouts
Design Sources/Reference Prototype/Vintage Posters
```

That yields predictable collision-free IDs such as:

```text
design-sources-brand-bible-visual-modes--archive-document
design-sources-reference-prototype-documents--ufo-dispatch
```

Do not title evaluation stories under `Brand/*`, `Design System/*`, or `Documents/*`. Those roots already imply official/canonical components.

If a prototype is accepted as production, adapt it into `src/components/design-system/research-ui/...` and co-locate its story there. Replace or refactor the overlapping existing story instead of maintaining a “new improved duplicate.”

## Relevant config constraints

- Story files under `docs/design/**` will not be discovered.
- Directly importing prototype code from `docs` is unsafe:
  - Its `@/*` alias means prototype root; Storybook forces `@` to `apps/app/src`.
  - Prototype assets live under its own `public`, but Storybook serves only `apps/app/public`.
  - Prototype Next/dependency assumptions differ from the app.
  - Tailwind source detection may not include the external docs tree.
- Global preview behavior forces dark theme, fullscreen layout, a centered padded flex wrapper, app/research toolbar selection, font selection, and global mindmap/reference-asset decorators.
- Large reference layouts will likely need a per-story decorator to neutralize that centered `p-6` wrapper.
- Reference images must be copied into `apps/app/public` or imported as modules; `/images/...` paths from the prototype’s own `public` directory will 404.
- The Storybook config and package files are currently modified by another active session. The story glob itself is unchanged.
